description: A utility module for a web application, providing functions for ID generation, user profile handling, markdown processing, date formatting, URL manipulation, clipboard operations, version checks, and other helper methods within a React-based frontend for Mattermost's Focalboard project.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A static utility class providing various helper functions for ID generation, string manipulation, date formatting, markdown processing, URL handling, and environment detection within the web application.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a globally unique identifier string prefixed with the specified IDType.

methods.name: blockTypeToIDType
methods.description: Converts a block type string to its corresponding IDType enum value.

methods.name: getProfilePicture
methods.description: Returns the profile picture URL for a user, or a default SVG if none is available.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a user based on configuration and user properties.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Constructs a full name string from user first and last names.

methods.name: randomArray
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array of specified size with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: base32encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base32 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a simple hash code for a string.

methods.name: htmlToElement
methods.description: Converts an HTML string into a DOM HTMLElement.

methods.name: getElementById
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID, asserting its existence.

methods.name: htmlEncode
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for HTML.

methods.name: htmlDecode
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities in a string.

methods.name: getTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string given a font descriptor.

methods.name: getFontAndPaddingFromCell
methods.description: Extracts font and padding info from a table cell element.

methods.name: getFontAndPaddingFromChildren
methods.description: Recursively computes font and padding info from child elements for table rendering.

methods.name: htmlFromMarkdown
methods.description: Converts markdown text to HTML with custom renderer.

methods.name: htmlFromMarkdownWithRenderer
methods.description: Converts markdown text to HTML using a specified marked renderer.

methods.name: countCheckboxesInMarkdown
methods.description: Counts total and checked checkboxes in markdown text.

methods.name: displayDate
methods.description: Formats a date for display based on locale.

methods.name: inputDate
methods.description: Formats a date for input fields.

methods.name: displayDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date and time for display.

methods.name: relativeDisplayDateTime
methods.description: Displays relative time (e.g., '2 hours ago') for a date.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: assertValue
methods.description: Logs an error if a value in an object is falsy.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Logs an error if a condition is false.

methods.name: assertFailure
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure (used in development).

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message with a timestamp.

methods.name: logWarn
methods.description: Logs a warning message with a timestamp.

methods.name: setFavicon
methods.description: Sets or removes the favicon icon in the document.

methods.name: replaceUrlQueryParam
methods.description: Replaces or removes a URL query parameter.

methods.name: ensureProtocol
methods.description: Ensures a URL has a protocol, defaulting to https.

methods.name: sanitizeFilename
methods.description: Removes illegal characters from filenames.

methods.name: selectLocalFile
methods.description: Opens a file picker dialog and executes a callback on file selection.

methods.name: arraysEqual
methods.description: Checks if two arrays are equal.

methods.name: arrayMove
methods.description: Moves an element within an array from one index to another.

methods.name: copyTextToClipboard
methods.description: Copies text to the clipboard.

methods.name: isMobile
methods.description: Detects if the user agent is a mobile device.

methods.name: getBaseURL
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the application.

methods.name: getFrontendBaseURL
methods.description: Returns the frontend base URL.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a path.

methods.name: roundTo
methods.description: Rounds a number to specified decimal places.

methods.name: isFocalboardLegacy
methods.description: Checks if the current route is a legacy Focalboard route.

methods.name: fixWSData
methods.description: Normalizes WebSocket message data into known types.

methods.name: fixBlock
methods.description: Converts a block to a specific type based on its 'type' property.

methods.name: fixBoard
methods.description: Creates a normalized Board object.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string.

methods.name: isDesktopApp
methods.description: Detects if running as a desktop Electron app.

methods.name: getDesktopVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the desktop app version.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: isDesktop
methods.description: Checks if the environment is a desktop app with version <= 5.0.0.

methods.name: getReadToken
methods.description: Extracts the 'r' read token from URL query parameters.

methods.name: generateClassName
methods.description: Generates a class string based on conditions.

methods.name: buildOriginalPath
methods.description: Builds a path string from optional team, board, view, and card IDs.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID string.

methods.name: isKeyPressed
methods.description: Checks if a specific key is pressed in a keyboard event.

methods.name: isMac
methods.description: Detects if the platform is Mac.

methods.name: cmdOrCtrlPressed
methods.description: Checks if command (Mac) or control (Windows) key is pressed.

methods.name: getBoardPagePath
methods.description: Returns the route path for a board page.

methods.name: showBoard
methods.description: Navigates to a specific board page.

methods.name: humanFileSize
methods.description: Converts bytes to a human-readable file size string.

methods.name: spaceSeparatedStringIncludes
methods.description: Checks if a string is included in a space-separated list.

methods.name: isSystemAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles string includes 'system_admin'.

methods.name: isTeamAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles string includes 'team_admin'.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if roles include either system or team admin roles.
